principle: Every reasonably automatable production behavior is inventoried and must map to an automated Release Gate / Play Store layer. Anything not automatable is explicitly listed as manual-only evidence.

coverageLayers.area: production source files/functions/event handlers/JSX controls/API handlers
all top-level routes and declared nested states plus safe interactive controls
all mutating workflows and destructive controls
roles, permission boundaries, owner/manager/staff/system-admin route access
API contracts, authorization, input fuzz/security headers
runtime JS execution coverage and route-loaded code
crash, recovery, chunk failure, offline/error pipeline
Ghost Mode Request Off creation/cancellation/listener recovery/admin restoration
coverage warning chronology and staggered-shift coverage engine
partial Request Off backwards-time validation in browser, server API, and rules
Schedule Builder sticky day/date header and horizontal column alignment

manualOnly.behavior: Google Play production-store install/update/signing propagation on a physical Android device
manualOnly.reason: Requires the external Play distribution channel and a physical/managed device; browser automation can verify PWA/installability artifacts but not Play rollout propagation.

manualOnly.behavior: OS-level push notification delivery/display while the physical device is killed, dozing, or vendor battery-optimized
manualOnly.reason: Requires a real mobile OS/device and external FCM delivery; automated tests verify payload, registration, dispatch, service-worker, and notification contracts.

manualOnly.behavior: Physical POS/KDS/printer/cash-drawer/tablet hardware behavior against customer hardware
manualOnly.reason: Requires hardware and external vendor systems; automated tests cover adapters, schemas, security boundaries, idempotency, and simulated provider behavior.
